title: Module version curation and automated compatibility checks for VPC IaC
creator: Liam Chen
description: Problem: Our Private/VPC IaC has grown ad-hoc provider and module version pins across repos. Upgrades are risky: breakages surface late during customer upgrades or emergency rollbacks. We need a curated, machine-readable compatibility matrix plus an automated scanner and CI enforcement so upgrades are tested, staged, and reversible with clear smoke checks.
acceptance_criteria:
- A canonical compatibility matrix (CSV/JSON) mapping module versions to provider versions and known-good runtime combos is authored and stored in the infra-repo.
- A GitHub Action 'compat-scanner' detects version drift in PRs and posts a report comment.
- CI runs a set of lightweight provisioning smoke checks (apply-plan, terraform validate, plan-diff) against a staging VPC for any module/provider version changes.
- A rollback playbook and automated gating rule exist: PRs that change pinned versions require an approval from Infra and are gated by 'compat-ci' passing.
- Dashboard card in Console shows pin statuses and last-verified timestamp.
deliverables:
- compatibility-matrix.json (.repo root)
- compat-scanner GH Action (actions/compat-scanner) + repo secret integration
- terraform-pr-template update + version-change lint rule
- smoke-check playbook (scripts/smoke) and terraform workspaces for staging
- Confluence runbook: 'IaC Version Curation & Rollback'
- Grafana/Console healthcard with 'last verified' and failing combos
approach_summary: 1) Data model: define minimal schema (module, module_source, module_version, provider, provider_version, tested_with_runtime) and a small set of 'compatibility notes' (breaking-change: true/false, mitigation). 2) Automation: compat-scanner reads changed files in PR, compares to canonical matrix, and flags unknown combos. 3) CI: when matrix changes or pins change, run smoke-checks in an isolated staging VPC; failures block the PR. 4) Rollouts: staged release window and incremental apply with monitored SLOs; immediate rollback tag + terraform state snapshot on failure.
technical_notes:
- Store canonical matrix as JSON Schema v1 under infra/compatibility/matrix.json.
- Use structured comments in GH (markdown) plus a machine-readable check-run annotation.
- Smoke-checks will be small TF modules that exercise networking, service endpoints, and core Redwood agents in a sandbox account. Aim for <10 minute CI runtime.
- Use existing provider-pin helper library (infra/tools/pinlib) and extend to produce provider compatibility warnings.
- Integrate with existing telemetry: emit 'compat-verification' events to Datadog/Grafana using existing infra gauges.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: Matrix becomes stale. Mitigation: add automation nightly reconciliation jobs and a monthly steward rotation.
- Risk: False-positives block valid PRs. Mitigation: allow 'experimental' tag in matrix for approved unverified combos and add infra-owner override in PR.
- Risk: CI runtime cost. Mitigation: limit full smoke-checks to matrix changes and run a fast lint for trivial version bumps.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Liam: Spike complete. Prototype matrix schema in infra repo (draft). Found three repos with inconsistent provider pins (aws 4.x vs 5.x). Filed follow-ups for repo owners.
2026-02-20 - Sofia: Design review with Security and Platform. Security requires explicit KMS policy check when pinning provider versions that affect state locking; added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-01 - PR #2483: compat-scanner MVP merged (reads changed files, compares to matrix). Early feedback: scanner reports too many unknowns for internal dev branches. Need allowlist for internal-only stacks.
2026-03-05 - Infra-Eng sync: Decided to gate 'matrix changes' with two approvals and require compat-ci green for any version pin updates. Action: add GH CODEOWNERS entry and update PR template.

2026-03-09 - QA: Smoke checks failing on provider aws 5.3.2 with module netstack v2.1. Reproduced in staging. Root cause: provider v5 changed default subnet creation behavior. Workaround: pin netstack to v2.0.x and open follow-up to update module to new defaults.
2026-03-12 - Sofia: Added nightly reconciler job doc and rotation schedule to Confluence. Next: instrument dashboard card and add 'last verified' timestamp to infra health view.
